environment_details.style_notes: High-fidelity 3D; exoskeleton has a 'hammered metal' or 'rough stone' texture; heavy, thick pincers (chelae); visible sensory hairs (trichobothria) on the legs.

visual_logic.composition: A top-down 'macro' view of a scorpion squeezed into a tight horizontal crack in a red sandstone wall. Its color perfectly matches the rock, making it almost invisible except for the glint of its many small eyes. The stinger is curled tightly over its back.
visual_logic.ground: Gritty, wind-blown red sand settled into the grooves of ancient, weathered rock.
visual_logic.lighting: Extreme contrast; the bright desert sun illuminates the sand outside the crack, while the scorpion remains in deep, cool violet shadows, highlighted by a single stray beam of light.
